findings.title: Chinese generic/non-proper phrases still become declarations
findings.trigger: 公司主要产品系列 / 各类产品 / 所有系列 / 上述系列产品 / 司开发的多款薄膜沉积产品 / 前道集成电路设备产品 / 可覆盖存储器件.
findings.evidence: Each returns a declaration; each closes 该系列产品 as unique. Real CN 8d73 (v2 unique) is now ambiguous family_count=4 with generic families 司开发的多款薄膜沉积产品, 薄膜沉积产品, 可覆盖存储器件.
findings.impact: Generic prose can donate the antecedent and wrong context; real CN unique is lost to false ambiguity; violates explicit named declaration (3/6.2).
findings.fix: Restrict CJK non-family heads to v2 conservative rule, or require declaration context evidence and stricter name boundaries; reject 上述/这些/所有/各类/主要/多款/前道/可覆盖... prefixes; add the listed negatives.

findings.title: Closure never matches deictic head/family to declaration head
findings.trigger: 公司推出Omega设备 + 该系列产品; 各类产品 + 该系列; 公司推出Alpha系列 + 这些设备.
findings.evidence: All return unique with the wrong-head declaration as context; families keyed only by declaration.family, never compared to ProductDeictic.head.
findings.impact: A device/product declaration can close a series deictic or vice versa; wrong antecedent context. Contract requires family/head correspondence.
findings.fix: Match deictic head class/family marker to declaration head/family; no match -> missing or legacy not_applicable; apply to internal and external declarations; add cross-head tests.

findings.title: Proper-name filter misses or mis-slices legitimate names
findings.trigger: iPhone 15 series; Model 3 系列; 3M系列; Preforma uniflash系列; Acme Products; ACME Systems; 小米系列产品.
findings.evidence: iPhone 15/Model 3/Preforma uniflash/Acme Products/ACME Systems -> no declaration/missing; 3M -> slice M系列; 小米系列产品 -> family 小米系列|product instead of 小米|series. Positive controls: 华为设备, XD-RIE设备, Galaxy S24系列, S24系列, Acme products work.
findings.impact: Over-deferral of legitimate declarations and wrong ref slices; CJK series family segmentation can cause false ambiguity.
findings.fix: Allow lowercase-start brands, digit-leading/digit-separated model tokens, case-insensitive English heads with original span; prefer family marker as CJK head; add the listed tests.

findings.title: Collective only after declaration; preposed 包括…在内 enumeration lost
findings.trigger: 公司推出包括SA/SU、SPTi在内的Preforma Uniflash系列产品.
findings.evidence: collective=False/members=(); postposed 包括... gives collective=True/members 3.
findings.impact: Legitimate collective members missing; member_refs incomplete; contract collective enumeration.
findings.fix: Allow a tightly bound preposed 包括/包含...在内 wrapper for the same declaration clause; keep rejecting unrelated customer lists; add pre/post tests.

findings.title: Attribution is prefix-keyword, not clause actor: customer actor can become issuer
findings.trigger: 公司客户高度认可X系列产品; 客户高度认可X系列产品.
findings.evidence: 公司客户... -> issuer/unique (actor is customers); 客户高度认可... -> quoted/missing (dropped entirely). 公司表示客户... -> issuer (reasonable).
findings.impact: Third-party customer statement can be treated as issuer (attribution violation); or legitimate product name is over-deferred.
findings.fix: Use clause subject/actor (existing NP grammar); 公司客户 -> quoted_related_party; keep quoted statements as attributed context rather than dropping; add actor tests.

findings.title: Generic English internal-control/accounting targets are over-gated
findings.trigger: HK The Board ... internal control systems ... Such systems; US accounting/internal control systems; products or services; platforms.
findings.evidence: Real current HK 2 unresolved (1 missing + 1 partial), US 11 unresolved (7 missing + 4 partial), all generic finance/control prose; gold remains 7/7,8/8.
findings.impact: Ordinary non-product prose is deferred as missing/partial; over-deferral and misleading REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED. Contract 3 requires actual product-deictic subject/object check.
findings.fix: Check deictic is a product NP subject/object (existing NP grammar) or require a product/brand context; avoid family gating on internal control/accounting systems; add HK/US text-level negatives.

findings.impact: Green suite cannot establish contract compliance; real CN ambiguous is untested.
findings.fix: Add RED tests for each listed counterexample; preserve RED->GREEN evidence.
